description: Create a custom QR code from any text or URL. Choose the size, foreground and background colors, and error correction level, then download it as a PNG.

faqs.a: Any text up to a few thousand characters — URLs, Wi‑Fi credentials, contact details, or plain text. Longer content makes a denser code that is harder to scan.
faqs.q: What can I encode in a QR code?

faqs.a: It adds redundancy so the code still scans if part of it is damaged or covered by a logo. Higher levels make the code denser; Medium is a good default.

howto: Type or paste the text or URL you want encoded.
Pick a size (256, 512 or 1024 px), colors, and error-correction level.
Click Generate QR Code to preview it.
Click Download PNG to save the code to your device.
